traps.text: Our first food pantry was sparked by a fire at the community centre in 1998, and it has opened every Saturday since.
traps.why: The first defect of this class. `parked (?:free )?(?:courtesy of|by)` shipped with no left boundary and matched inside `sparked by`; its only two matches in 44,284 corpus pages were live organization sites of about 3,000 characters that the instrument was reporting unreachable. PARKED_RX carries `\bparked` because of this sentence.

traps.text: Send us a message using the form below. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.
traps.why: The second defect of this class. The bare word `captcha` matched inside `reCAPTCHA` in the footer sentence every GoDaddy, Wix and Squarespace contact page prints, and left 64 live organization pages unreachable. The wall vocabulary now asks to SOLVE one, so neither form matches this; a bare token added back would move only one of them.

The intended difference, and the reason this test asks for a comment instead of a boundary. `doGTranslate` is GTranslate's own function name and the vendor's marker on pages that carry nothing else; core.py records that `doGTranslate` was dropped from the pattern precisely because `gtranslate` already matched inside it, measured at 0 organizations added over 45,100. A left boundary here would lose that marker.

traps.text: Before you launch, work through our security checklist and confirm every volunteer account has been reviewed.
traps.why: What this gate does NOT cover, stated so that nobody reads it as covering more. A left word boundary says nothing about the right-hand side, and `security check` matches inside `security checklist` under both forms. Whether the wall vocabulary needs a right boundary as well is a separate question and a measurement, not a transcription.

traps.text: The centre offers weekend English classes, a legal clinic on Tuesdays, and a food pantry that any resident of the county may use without an appointment.
traps.why: A negative control. An ordinary page of an organization carries none of this vocabulary, and a corpus made only of positives cannot show that.

traps.text: Nuestro centro ofrece clases de inglés, asesoría legal y una despensa de alimentos abierta a cualquier residente del condado.
traps.why: The same negative control in Spanish. Every gate in this family was written in English, and the pages it must not reach are not all in English.
